Product innovation

Myntum products for ADAS teams

Explore software and hardware platforms intended to help engineering teams develop and integrate ADAS features. Contact us for product specifications, availability and validation details.

◆ Flagship platform
MyntSense™ Fusion Core
Our flagship multi-sensor fusion middleware. MyntSense™ aggregates up to 16 sensors across camera, LiDAR, radar and ultrasonic modalities, designed to support a unified environment model for ADAS applications. Actual performance and safety scope depend on the configured system.
Real-time 360° occupancy grid generation
Supports AUTOSAR Adaptive & Classic
Safety-engineering support for applicable ASIL targets
Hardware-agnostic deployment layer
◇ Software SDK
MyntVision SDK
A developer-first SDK for rapid ADAS prototyping — pre-trained detection models, calibration tools, ROS2 integration and a Python/C++ API covering the full perception pipeline.
Pre-trained YOLO + BEV models
ROS2 & AUTOSAR integration
One-click HIL deployment
◈ Hardware platform
MyntEdge ECU
An automotive-grade embedded compute platform for ADAS workloads, built around NVIDIA Orin with an embedded software platform, OTA capabilities and automotive-focused power-management design.
NVIDIA Orin-based compute option
Automotive-grade component options (configuration dependent)
OTA & remote diagnostics
◉ Data platform
MyntData™ Pipeline
End-to-end automotive data infrastructure — vehicle-side collection, cloud ingestion, annotation workflows and model training pipelines optimised for ADAS scale.
Automated data labelling
Scenario mining & ODD analysis
MLOps-ready training loop
GDPR & data governance

About Myntum

About Myntum

Myntum works across automotive engineering, software and artificial intelligence. We help teams work on driver-assistance and mobility technology, with engineering support across software, integration and validation.

Our work supports automotive manufacturers, suppliers and mobility startups with engineering services and technology support to move projects from early concepts toward real-world use.

Our culture is built on careful engineering, clear communication and a focus on making vehicle technology more useful and reliable.

01
Safety-first architecture
Fail-operational redundancy and ASIL-D discipline across every system we touch.
02
Real-time edge intelligence
Sub-10ms inference on automotive SoCs — no cloud dependency in the critical loop.
03
Scalable across platforms
Software that adapts from compact ECUs to high-compute autonomous platforms.
